head: feature/task/T-055
title: F-FND-007 Blob Foundation (T-007): IBlobStore port + TA-3.6 SAS minting + canonical staging paths + round-trip proof
body:
## Summary

Closes milestone **T-007 / F-FND-007** — the blob foundation: one storage account with two containers (`staging`, `transfers`), an `IBlobStore` port in `wa.application` with the Azure/Azurite adapter in `wa.infrastructure`, and TA-3.6-exact SAS minting so the browser holds a 2-hour `cwr` URL, never an account key. T-010's server-side blob copy and T-016's download SAS reuse this exact machinery.

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-055-1 draft upload SAS works end-to-end (plain HTTP, no credentials) | T-055-05 — `SasRoundTripTests`: mint → block blob PUT via plain `HttpClient` (only header `x-ms-blob-type`) against live Testcontainers Azurite 3.37.0 → read back through the real adapter; asserts exact bytes and the full staging path |
| AC-055-2 URL shape is exactly TA-3.6 + signature verifies independently | T-055-04 — `BlobSasMinterTest`: sp/sr/sv=2024/st/se pinned per purpose (draft cwr 2h with st, recipient file/zip r 30min without) against a fixed clock; FR-055-6 via an independent HMAC-SHA256 re-sign (the test builds its own string-to-sign, no minter internals reused) |
| AC-055-3 staging path is canonical | T-055-01 — `BlobPaths` single source of truth; grep audit: container literals appear in code only via the constants (bootstrap fix commit); round-trip test builds its path from `BlobPaths.StagingFile` |

EC-055-3 (SAS leaks into logs): `SigMask.MaskSig` extension masks `sig=` per TA-9.6, logged URL stays diagnosable. FR-055-4 topology: one account / two containers via `BlobContainerBootstrap` hosted service (idempotent create + the 12.29.2-expressible bits, the rest logged as notes for a later REST round-trip). EC-055-1 retry-after-expiry is T-012's re-mint path — this test deliberately leaves per-block retry semantics out of scope.

## Changes

**New code:**
- `src/wa.application/Blob/BlobPaths.cs` — TA-3.5 canonical layout (staging/transfer rows), no string interpolation outside it
- `src/wa.application/Ports/BlobStore.cs` — `IBlobStore` port (TA-0.2 rule 7)
- `src/wa.infrastructure/Blob/AzureBlobStore.cs` — Azure/Azurite adapter (dual ctor: config+logger, or pre-built client for tests; `SplitPath` fail-fast on non-canonical paths)
- `src/wa.infrastructure/Blob/BlobSasMinter.cs` — TA-3.6 exact URL shapes (cwr 2 h / r 30 min, sv=2024): takes the frozen SDK's bit-exact query + string-to-sign, swaps only sv/sig; `SigMask` log helper
- `src/wa.infrastructure/Blob/BlobContainerBootstrap.cs` — hosted service: both containers idempotent (via `BlobPaths` constants), soft-delete 14 d ON (service-level), non-expressible lifecycle bits logged
- `Program.cs`: DI via §5.2 config only (`Wa:Blob:*`), no fake branch; launchSettings dev key fixed to the canonical Azurite value (TA-14.3 parity)

**New tests:** 4 xUnit total — `BlobSasMinterTest` ×3 (application.unit, pure HMAC over a frozen string-to-sign) + `SasRoundTripTests` ×1 (api.integration, Testcontainers Azurite pinned 3.37.0 because frozen SDK 12.29.2 sends service version 2026-06-06). Plus the `HealthFailureTests` env-var fix: Program.cs's eager BlobServiceClient DI needs `Wa__Blob__*` set before host start under TestHost (launchSettings aren't loaded there).

**Docs:** milestone rows ☑, T-055-01…05 exit boxes flipped with actual counts (domain.unit 3/3, application.unit 25/25, api.integration 10/10), T-007 → done.

## Gate

Build 0 errors; domain.unit **3/3**; application.unit **25/25**; api.integration **10/10** (Docker). Web lint/test/build green.

Review: in-session review across three reports (.omp/review-fnd007-{app,infra,tests}.md) — all PASS; one real fix applied post-review (bootstrap container literals → `BlobPaths` constants), suites re-run green.
